entities.name: Helga
entities.description: A frogfolk with visions who, through a calm doodle in a scrying bowl, divines that Cruelclaw has gone to Fountainport.

entities.name: Mabel
entities.description: A mousefolk baker and fighter who leads the band and pledges to return the stolen Calamity Beast egg.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker turned otterfolk who calls lightning against a dragon-hawk and misses his husband Tomik.

entities.name: Finneas
entities.description: A rabbitfolk archer who doubts the quest and shoots a copper-wire arrow into the dragon-hawk.

entities.name: Hugs
entities.description: A badgerfolk who knows a dandelion field shortcut and carries Zoraline.

entities.name: Gev
entities.description: A lizardfolk fire-mace fighter and braggart who scouts ahead.

entities.name: Zoraline
entities.description: A batfolk cleric who guides Helga and sneezes awake at a bad moment.

entities.name: Coffey
entities.description: A wizened ratfolk elder with mismatched eyes who leads the lorekeepers and shows the party an image of Cruelclaw.

entities.name: Tucker
entities.description: A molefolk lorekeeper in spectacles who serves tea and guides the party out.

entities.name: Cruelclaw
entities.description: A scarred weaselfolk mercenary in a hooded red tailcoat who stole a Calamity Beast egg and leads a band including necromancers.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: The planeswalker Ral is chasing.

entities.name: Tomik
entities.description: Ral's husband, whom he misses.

entities.name: King Glarb
entities.description: The weaver whose domain, Fountainport, is the party's destination.

entities.name: Maha, the Night Owl
entities.description: The Calamity Beast that follows Cruelclaw's trail wreaking havoc.

entities.name: The Flood Gar
entities.description: A Calamity Beast that attacked Three Tree City's docklands.

entities.name: The dragon-hawk
entities.description: A four-winged, crested, lightning-wreathed bird-like creature, said by Ral to be an animal-shifted dragon from another plane, who attacks the party.

entities.name: Calamity Beast egg
entities.description: An egg from which a new Calamity Beast will someday be born, which Cruelclaw stole.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Natural-disaster creatures of Bloomburrow.

entities.name: Ratfolk lorekeepers
entities.description: A community of ratfolk who preserve Bloomburrow's history in an ossuary beneath the marsh.

entities.name: Cruelclaw's band
entities.description: The mercenaries and necromancers led by Cruelclaw.

entities.name: The ratfolk village
entities.description: A system of ancient burrows beneath the marsh where the lorekeepers live and store lore.

entities.name: Fountainport
entities.description: The domain of King Glarb, to which Cruelclaw has gone.

entities.name: The dandelion field
entities.description: A shortcut full of dandelions and hedge parsley where the dragon-hawk attacks.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: A city whose docklands were attacked by the Flood Gar.

entities.name: Ever-Burning Oak
entities.description: A warm place Gev claims to have visited.

entities.name: Order of the Holly Leaf
entities.description: An order of heroes from the era of great weavers.

events.summary: The party is surrounded by ratfolk in a cavern, but elder Coffey calls them guests and invites them in.
events.quote: "The River brought them to us. We must offer them hospitality."

events.summary: Coffey explains they are lorekeepers who preserve Bloomburrow's history.
events.quote: We preserve the history of Bloomburrow and Valley within it.

events.summary: Coffey shows an image of Cruelclaw, a scarred weaselfolk mercenary leading a band through the swamp, the Night Owl in his wake.
events.quote: He led his band through the swamp, pilfering what supplies he pleased, the Night Owl wreaking havoc in his wake.

events.summary: Coffey reveals that Cruelclaw stole a Calamity Beast egg, which may give him power over the beasts.
events.quote: Our scouts reported that he had in his possession a Calamity Beast egg.

events.summary: Mabel resolves to find whoever commands Cruelclaw and return the egg to its place.
events.quote: "Then we return the egg to its rightful place."

events.summary: Ral pledges to keep the group alive as long as Helga is his link to Jace.
events.quote: so long as Helga is my only link to Beleren, I'll be sure to keep you all alive.

events.summary: Helga attempts an augury with a basin of water, and after calming her mind sketches Fountainport's fountain, divining Cruelclaw's destination.
The party leaves the ratfolk village; Tucker warns of a strange dangerous creature near the shortcut.
events.quote: I'm told it's not a Calamity Beast, but it's very like one.

events.summary: On the dandelion shortcut, Ral tells Mabel he misses his husband Tomik.
A vast shadow passes and a storm gathers, revealing a four-winged lightning-wreathed dragon-hawk.
events.quote: A giant creature hovered in the air, purple lightning crackling across its body.

events.summary: Ral identifies the creature as an animal-shifted dragon from another plane.
Zoraline sneezes awake and the dragon-hawk dives at the party.
events.quote: It swooped toward the party, who alternately ducked or scattered.

events.summary: Finneas shoots a copper-wire arrow, Zoraline disorients the creature, and Ral channels a storm of lightning into it.
events.quote: The wild, natural energy tore from the clouds, striking the head of the dragon-hawk

events.summary: The dragon-hawk retreats into the clouds and the party shelters under a boulder with Helga's water barrier.
events.quote: The falling drops solidified into a thin barrier perpendicular to the rock

events.summary: Mabel leads the group onward to Fountainport.

relations.note: Coffey is the elder who welcomes the party and speaks for the lorekeepers.
relations.quote: I am Coffey, and you must rest and eat before you proceed.

relations.note: Tucker serves tea at Coffey's request.

relations.quote: He led his band through the swamp
Beleren is slippery as a damn eel

relations.note: Hugs and Gev travel together and Gev picks seeds from Hugs's fur.
